objective.name: mailbox.read
objective.description: Selects and claims the next mailbox entry eligible for consumption by the active run of a continuity, through one guarded mailbox write.

#root.role: Give the active run exclusive ownership of the next eligible mailbox message of an explicitly requested priority class, according to deterministic continuity message ordering.

kind._comment: Optional. 'user': absorption read. With priority normal, only entries whose durable message has kind user are eligible; the claimed entry is not made the current message of the run (it is absorbed by the chain in progress).

effects.mailbox: Changes exactly one eligible mailbox entry from pending to claimed by the active run, through one mailbox write guarded by expected_revision.
effects.runtime: Reads active ownership state to verify that the caller is the current cognitive run.
effects.journal: Reads durable message ordering information from the journal without modifying it.

transformation_contract.morphing: A mailbox containing pending eligible work becomes a mailbox where the deterministic next entry is exclusively claimed by the active run.
invariants: Only the current runtime.run_id may claim mailbox work.
Selection and claim form one atomic mailbox mutation: a single matter.write guarded by expected_revision; on conflict the mailbox is re-read and the selection recomputed.
One mailbox entry can have at most one owner.
Only pending entries are eligible.
Expected entries captured by an active wait group are never selected by mailbox.read.
Only entries of the requested priority class, normal or control, are selected; priority classes are never mixed.
The priority parameter accepts only normal or control; expected is forbidden because expected entries are captured directly by mailbox.send.
Within one priority, the referenced continuity message with the lowest seq is selected first.
With kind user, only normal entries whose durable message has kind user are eligible; other normal messages keep waiting for their own treatment.
A parked entry (status failed) is never claimed.
Physical order of mailbox.entries is irrelevant.
The journal is never mutated by mailbox.read.

Mutations of the Matters of one continuity are serialized by short critical-section locks keyed by continuity_id inside the agentic_core wrapper process: a lock is held only around a read, recompute and guarded write, never during an LLM inference, an external invoke or a wait; it is never the sole guarantee.
Every write to a mutable Matter carries expected_revision; a revision conflict causes a bounded read, recompute and retry.
Revision is opaque concurrency metadata and is never used as an application sequence.
The operation mutates a single Matter through one matter.write guarded by expected_revision, and is atomic at the engine level for that Matter only.
A mailbox entry whose message_id matches no durable message in the journal is never eligible for claim.
success: The next eligible entry of the requested priority class is selected deterministically.
The selected entry becomes status claimed.
The returned message_id references the canonical durable message in the journal.
No available eligible message is a valid empty result rather than an execution error.
failure: Fails if continuity, mailbox, or runtime are inconsistent.
Fails if run_id is not the current runtime.run_id.
Fails if mailbox ownership state is internally contradictory.
Fails if priority is expected or is not one of normal or control.
Does not alter any entry when ownership validation fails.
Fails explicitly with a concurrency failure when the bounded retries on revision conflict are exhausted.
notes: Executed by the agentic_core Python wrapper.
This capacity does not perform cognition and does not read message payload semantically.
It delegates no architectural behavior to another capacity; its responsibility is one local mailbox transformation applied by a single guarded write.
Setting runtime.current_message_id belongs to pilot.activate after a successful claim, not to mailbox.read itself.
Controls are read by pilot.activate at safe points with priority control, repeatedly until none remains pending, ordered by message seq; normal work is read with priority normal.
The concurrency model of agentic_core is defined once in the document agentic_core_concurrency_model.

Implementation constraint: the existence and the order (seq) of the eligible messages are read from the in-memory object that duplicates the continuity for performance, rebuilt from the journal when absent.

#resolve_state.role: Derive the four Matters owned by the target continuity (header, journal, mailbox, runtime) from continuity_id.

failure: Fails if one of the four derived Matters does not exist.
invariants: Matter IDs follow the convention continuity_<id> (header), journal_<id>, mailbox_<id>, runtime_<id>.
Resolution is deterministic and requires no caller-provided Matter.
transformation_contract.morphing: A continuity_id becomes the physical Matter IDs of its continuity header, journal, mailbox, and runtime.

#authorize.role: Verify that the requesting run is the unique active owner of the continuity.

failure: Mismatched or absent active ownership rejects the read without mutation.
invariants: The supplied run_id must equal runtime.run_id.
An idle or suspended continuity cannot consume normal mailbox work.
transformation_contract.morphing: A mailbox read request becomes an authorized or rejected consumption attempt.
success: The current active run is authorized to proceed.

#eligible_entries.role: Identify mailbox entries eligible for ordinary run consumption.

invariants: claimed entries are excluded.
expected entries are excluded.
Entries of any other priority class are excluded.
Entries whose message_id matches no durable message in the journal are excluded.
transformation_contract.morphing: Mailbox entries become the subset currently eligible for read consumption.

#priority_order.role: Order eligible entries of the requested priority class by referenced message seq.

invariants: All eligible entries share the requested priority class.
FIFO within equal priority derives exclusively from continuity message seq.
transformation_contract.morphing: Eligible mailbox entries become one deterministic next-consumption candidate.

#select.role: Determine the next eligible pending mailbox entry using priority and canonical message sequence order.

invariants: Only status pending entries participate.
Expected entries are excluded from normal selection.
Only entries of the requested priority class participate.
Within equal priority, lower continuity message seq precedes higher seq.
transformation_contract.morphing: Pending mailbox state becomes one deterministic candidate entry or an explicit no-work result.

#claim.role: Transfer exclusive consumption ownership of the selected entry to the requesting run through one guarded mailbox write.

failure: If the entry is no longer pending, the claim fails rather than stealing ownership.
invariants: The entry must still be pending at the instant of claim.
Selection and claim are one mailbox write guarded by expected_revision; a revision conflict re-reads the mailbox and recomputes the selection.
status becomes claimed and claimed_by becomes run_id together.
transformation_contract.morphing: A selected pending mailbox entry becomes exclusively claimed by the active run.
success: Exactly one selected entry becomes owned by the run.

#return_message_ref.role: Return the durable message reference and ordering metadata of the newly claimed mailbox entry.

invariants: The message payload itself remains canonical in the journal.
Returning the reference performs no additional state change.
transformation_contract.morphing: A successfully claimed mailbox entry becomes an explicit message reference returned to the active run.
